narr: An approaching 50+ knot jet and a mid level disturbance contributed to strong to severe thunderstorms developing along the Rio Grande Valley. Flash flooding was reported near Radium Springs and severe wind gusts near Percha Creek.
ev: New Mexico Highway 185 was closed between mile markers 18 and 24 due to flooding.
lsr: NM-185 closed between mile markers 18 and 24 due to flooding.
